scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @elevator/shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web "npm run dev --workspace @elevator/api" "npm run dev --workspace @elevator/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @elevator/shared && npm run dev --workspace @elevator/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @elevator/shared && npm run dev --workspace @elevator/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @elevator/shared && npm run build --workspace @elevator/api && npm run build --workspace @elevator/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @elevator/shared && npm run lint --workspace @elevator/api && npm run lint --workspace @elevator/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @elevator/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @elevator/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @elevator/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @elevator/shared && npm run test --workspace @elevator/api && npm run test --workspace @elevator/web
